name: Agentic_RAG_Knowledge_Search
description: A production-ready AI Microservice that uses an Agentic Router to intelligently decide between retrieving answers from user provided documents (RAG) or searching the live web and does self-Evaluation

paragraphs: An agentic RAG assistant that decides where to find an answer (your uploaded documents or the live web), then scores its own answer for hallucinations, all running on free/CPU infrastructure.
Built with LangGraph, FastAPI, Gradio, FAISS, Google Gemini, and Docker.
🔗 Live Demo on HuggingFace Spaces » : bring your own free Gemini key and try it.
features: Self-evaluating: each response is scored for faithfulness (hallucination detection via NLI), answer relevance, and optional accuracy, computed locally and shown live in the UI.
Hallucination detection that works: it uses natural-language entailment, not just embedding similarity, so it catches answers that contradict the source (which cosine similarity misses).
Runtime document upload: drop in PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, or CSV files; they're indexed instantly and searched first.
Conversational memory: follow-up questions resolve correctly, and older turns are auto-summarized to bound token cost in long chats.
Bring Your Own Key (BYOK): each user supplies their own Gemini key, so the public demo costs the owner nothing and never exhausts a shared quota.

whatItDoes.text: An agentic RAG assistant that decides where to find an answer (your uploaded documents or the live web), then scores its own answer for hallucinations, all running on free/CPU infrastructure.

requirements.text: Prerequisites: Python 3.10+, a free Google Gemini API key, Docker (optional).
No API-key secret is required: the app uses BYOK, so each visitor enters their own Gemini key in the UI.
